content: Yau bana, taugu nuaguma e ḡoeḡoe kaue be Mamaitua yàwai baḡana da tauna sibo Israel banegidima yai yawasanidina.
Taugu è kataiena da taudi ta rarau rubu guratana da Mamaitua sibo a tainuaverena, be tauna anitai nuaverenama na kedama, nam ti katai kauena.
Taudi Mamaitua na didimana kedanama a riutuaḡaie, be taudi adi noḡotama nama na ruvae didimana kedanama a wanewanena.
Be taudi nam ti kataiena da Keriso ya voie da tarawatu na raḡanima ya kovina. Be aitau da Keriso ewai sumaḡena, tauna tokare didimana e banavina.
Mousis didimana tarawatue umanama ya giuedina, “Aitauḡa uma kauidima yà giugiuedina e voiedina, tauna tokare ḡarodie yawasana e banavina.”
Be didimana waisumaḡe inam umanama ya giuedina, “Nam nopomie ko riuna, ‘Aitau e saḡa e naḡo marae be Keriso e yovoḡe?’”
Bo “Aitau e yovo e naḡo guriguridima adi gabue be Keriso e saḡe?” Ibewa!

Inam kauidie nam tokare yawasana ko banavidi. Be you, didimana waisumaḡe umanama ya giuedina, “Yawasana riunama inam ḡaromie; mudumie be nopomie.” Inam riunama vutuna waisumaḡa riunama tauma ka rarau guguyena.

Inam giudima banidima umanama, Deḡoda tam mudume kwa riuna, “Yesu tauna Bada” be nopome kwai sumaḡa da Mamaitua Keriso gurie be ya kawa midisuḡu munaḡena, tam tokare yawasana kenakena nonoḡinama kwa banavina.
Baninama dà waisumaḡe tokare Mamaitua e kawa didimanidana, be deḡoda mudude Yesu Keriso tà giuena, tauda tokare Mamaitua ei yawasanidana.
Vutuna aubainama girugiruminama umanama ya riuna, “Aitau tauna ḡarone ewai sumaḡana, tauna tokare nam tunimayaḡe e mia.”

Yodi uma giunama mayanama maika banaga matabuda, tauda Jius be eteni banegidima matabuda e riuriuedana, baninama Bada tauna tenaḡa, be banaga matabuna ewai badedina, be vere dosidima aitauḡa tauna ḡarone sagu tawai baḡena e uteutedina,
baninama girugiruminama nama ya riuna, “Aitauḡa Bada ḡarone yawasana tawai baḡena, taudi tokare ei yawasanidina.”

Be nema taudi sagu tai baḡe bake, deḡoda taudi Bada nam tai sumaḡe? Be nema Bada tai sumaḡa bake, deḡoda varinama nam ta vaie? Be nema vari verenama ta vaia bake, deḡoda nam aitau ḡarodie e rauguguya?

Be nema taudi ta rauguguya bako, deḡoda Keriso taurauguguya nam e riuporaḡa? Girugiruminama umanama ya riuna: “Banaga tawai nuavere kauana raḡanine taurauguguya ta verau be vari verena be suba giunama ta rarau guguyena.”
Be nam Israel banegidima matabudi vari verenama ti paḡona. Inam maika peroveta Aisaia ya riuriuna nama: “Bada, nam banaga toitoi ama giuma ti sumaḡena.”
Be yaḡoro Keriso banaga ya riuporedina rauguguya aubainama be adi rauguguyae banaga ta vaie, be tai sumaḡana.
Be Jius banegidima nemanama? Taudi vari verenama nam ti vaie, bo? Ibewa da taudi kaite a vaiena. Baninama girugiruminama porane ya riuna umanama:

content.text: “Taudi a rarau guguyana varinama dobu matabuna yai moḡavuna,

content: Bo agunai Jius banegidima a vaiena be baninama nam ti katai kaue, bo? Ibewa, taudi a kataiena. Uma kauinama vutuna aubainama Mamaitua Mousis umanama ya riuena:

content.text: “Avedi da eteni banegidima buebuedima taudi nam Jius, be tokare yà vinedina.
Yodibe taumi tokare ko unuredi be ko mediedina.”

content: Be Aisaia mate umanama ya riuna:

content.text: taudi ḡarodie è maḡatara be a banaviguna.”

content: Be Israel banegidima aubaidima umanama ya riuna:

content.text: “Raḡan daudaunama taugu aubaimima èwai rabana da sibo ḡarogue koya tavana,
be taumi nam ko tavana, baninama taumi banaga beapotepotemi be raraukosoḡaiḡaimima.”
